purpose: Parses an MPP (Machine Payments Protocol) session, validates spend cap and session terms, maps HTTP-402 flow to AP2 Intent→Cart→Payment, performs KYA agent identity check (did:key format), models settlement cost, and emits a signed agent-payment mandate. W-C co-lead. ISO 20022 pacs.008-subset artifact; did:key identity in debtor field.
